applicationFee.note: Department says a fee waiver may be possible after identifying an advisor willing to support the application; no citizenship restriction on this route is stated, so confirm international eligibility. Central page says waivers unavailable in most circumstances. Integrative/Marine pages separately name underrepresented US minority waiver category.

english.note: PTE 59 or TOEFL Essentials 8.5 also listed. Tests valid two years. US bachelor’s-or-higher or documented English-medium foreign bachelor’s-or-higher may support a waiver request through the portal; approval required by department/Graduate School, not automatic.

documents: Transcripts from all postsecondary institutions, translated into English where necessary (PDF copies for application; official after admission)
Personal statement on reasons, immediate/long-range objectives, research/professional interests and experience
Three recommendation letters; not relatives/friends and not older than one year
requirements.note: Department explicitly distinguishes Integrative Biology, Marine Biology and Neuroscience & Behavior as separate graduate programs. Contact potential faculty mentors before applying; a required admission-stage advisor agreement is not established.

funding.note: Department generally admits when funding can support degree, typically including tuition/health insurance waivers through mixed assistantships; no unconditional guarantee. Central international rules explicitly discuss assistantships and tuition waiver subject to eligible visa status.
